target_claim: For either stated construction of the metabelian Lie algebra \overline{L}, every nonzero v\in V_0 induces an injective map \ad(v):\gr_i(\overline{L})\to\gr_{i+1}(\overline{L}) for all i.
source_quote:
Let $\overline{L}$ be a free metabelian Lie algebra on a $\Q _p $-vector space $V_0$ of dimension $>1$, or the quotient of a free metabelian Lie algebra on a $\Q _p$-vector space $V_0$ of dimension $>2$ by the $\widehat{\Sym}^{\bullet }(V_0 )$-modules generated by an element of $[L,L]$. Then, for all non-zero $v$ in $V_0$, the map
\[
\ad (v):\gr _i (\overline{L})\to \gr _{i+1}(\overline{L} )
\]
is injective.
